name: com.0xpi.scholar/study-tools
title: Scholarize: Study Plans, Citations, Quizzes & Flashcards
description: Study plan, thesis and citation previews; full results, quizzes and flashcards need an account.

tools.name: generate_study_plan
tools.description: Create a personalized week-by-week study plan for a student from their syllabus, exam topics, or a description of what they need to study. Returns the plan summary and a shareable link to the full plan. Without a connected Scholarize account it returns a preview: the summary and week 1. Use it when a student asks for help planning their studying or exam prep.

syllabus.description: The syllabus, exam topics, or a description of what to study (at least ~10 characters).
examples: Biology exam: cell division, genetics, evolution

email.description: Optional. The student’s email, only if they choose to give it. Not needed for the result.

tools.name: generate_thesis_statement
tools.description: Generate strong thesis statement options for an essay from a topic, the essay type (argumentative, expository, analytical, compare-contrast), and an optional stance. Without a connected Scholarize account it returns one thesis option as a preview. Use it when a student needs a thesis or essay direction.

examples: The impact of social media on teenage mental health

email.description: Optional. The student’s email, only if they choose to give it. Not needed for the result.

tools.name: generate_citation
tools.description: Generate a formatted citation for a source in five styles (APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, IEEE) from the source type and details. Without a connected Scholarize account it returns the APA version as a preview. Use it when a student needs to cite a book, journal article, website, or other source for an essay or paper.

type.description: Source type: book, journal, website, newspaper or report.

authors.description: Author names as a list, e.g. ["Smith, J.", "Doe, A."].

url.description: URL (for a website or online source).

email.description: Optional. The student’s email, only if they choose to give it. Not needed for the result.

tools.name: ask_ai_tutor
tools.description: Ask the Scholarize Tutor a question and get a step-by-step explanation, on the connected student account (counts toward their plan). Use for "explain X", "help me understand Y", or homework/concept questions. Requires the student to have connected their Scholarize account to this assistant (a token from Scholarize Settings).

question.description: The question to ask the tutor.

tools.name: generate_quiz
tools.description: Generate a practice quiz on a topic for the connected student, saved to their Scholarize account. Requires a connected Scholarize account.

tools.name: generate_flashcards
tools.description: Generate a set of study flashcards from a topic or from pasted notes, saved to the connected student Scholarize account. Requires a connected Scholarize account.

notes.description: Optional notes/document text to build cards from.

tools.name: list_my_flashcards
tools.description: List the connected student saved flashcard sets in Scholarize. Requires a connected Scholarize account.

tools.name: list_my_quizzes
tools.description: List the connected student saved quizzes in Scholarize. Requires a connected Scholarize account.
